The '''EG-7''' was a model of [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] produced by [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]]. [[Jeigh Esse]] used a modified EG-7 known as a [[polarizer]].

==Behind the scenes==
The EG-7 was created by [[Chris Cowdrill]], a ''[[Star Wars]]'' fan, for the backstory of their [[Jeigh Esse]] entry in the [[Design An Alien]] contest held in the ''[[Star Wars Galaxy Magazine]]s''.
